# `armada node`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Also: `nodes`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada node delete`](#armada-node-delete) | Move a node's replicas away, then delete it and revoke its certificate |
| [`armada node drain`](#armada-node-drain) | Stop placing replicas on a node and move its replicas away |
| [`armada node join-token`](#armada-node-join-token) | Create a single-use token that adds a node, and print the join command |

## `armada node delete`

Drain the node, wait until its replicas run elsewhere (moved like a rolling
update), then delete it from the cluster and revoke its certificate.

--force deletes the node at once and its replicas without draining; use it
only for a node that is gone for good. A node holding volumes is only deleted
with --force; their records stay so a backup can be restored elsewhere.

```
armada node delete NODE [flags]
```

Also: `rm`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | delete now, with its replicas, without draining |
| `--wait duration` | how long to wait for replicas to move (default `10m0s`) |

## `armada node drain`

Stop placing replicas on a node and move its replicas away.

```
armada node drain NODE
```

## `armada node join-token`

Create a single-use join token and print the command to run on the new node.

The token is a credential: anyone holding it before it expires can add a node.
Send it over a trusted channel. Only a hash is stored on the server.

```
armada node join-token [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--label stringArray` | label KEY=VALUE for the node that joins with the token (repeatable) |
| `--ttl duration` | token lifetime (1m to 24h) (default `1h0m0s`) |

## `armada node label`

Set labels with KEY=VALUE and remove them with KEY-. Apps choose nodes by
label with placement.require (see the spec reference). Replicas whose node no
longer matches their app's placement move to other nodes, without dropping
below the serving count.

Keys are lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-', '_', and '/'; values the same
without '/'. Keys starting with "armada." are set by Armada (armada.os,
armada.arch) and cannot be changed.

```
armada node label NODE KEY=VALUE... | KEY-...
```

Examples:

```bash
armada node label raspi-1 region=sulawesi kind=raspi
armada node label raspi-1 kind-
```

## `armada node list`

List nodes.

```
armada node list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada node restrict`

Run only apps whose placement selects one of the node's labels.

```
armada node restrict NODE
```

## `armada node resume`

Let a drained node take replicas again.

```
armada node resume NODE
```

```

```
